mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gemdori_review_tbl ( REVIEW_CODE, USER_CODE, REVIEW_CONTENTS, RATING, WRITE_DATE, GAME_CODE ) VALUES ( 'R' || TO_CHAR(REVIEW_SEQ.NEXTVAL + 99999), #{userCode}, #{reviewContents}, #{rating}, SYSDATE, #{gameCode} )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.REVIEW_CODE, r.USER_CODE, r.REVIEW_CONTENTS, r.RATING, r.WRITE_DATE, r.GAME_CODE,
p.USER_NICKNAME, p.USER_IMAGE FROM gemdori_review_tbl r JOIN gemdori_user_profile_tbl p ON r.USER_CODE = p.USER_CODE WHERE r.GAME_CODE = #{gameCode} ORDER BY r.WRITE_DATE DESC
